description: Source code for schema matching and operator invocation in TorchScript JIT frontend, including functions for type unwrapping, implicit conversions, schema matching, and operator call emission.

methods.name: unwrapOptional
methods.description: Recursively unwraps an optional type to its underlying type.

methods.name: convertibleToList
methods.description: Checks if a type can be converted to a list type, considering tuples and subtypes.

methods.name: tryConvertToType
methods.description: Attempts implicit conversion of a value to a specified type, including tensor and string conversions.

methods.name: tryMatchArgument
methods.description: Checks if a value can match a function argument, performing conversions if allowed.

methods.name: findInputWithName
methods.description: Finds the index of an input argument by name in kwargs.

methods.name: tryCreateList
methods.description: Creates a list node from varargs if types match the element type.

methods.name: varargsCanBeUsedAsList
methods.description: Determines if remaining arguments can be used as a list argument.

methods.name: isBlockListedSchema
methods.description: Checks if a schema is blocklisted due to known issues or unsupported features.

methods.name: tryMatchSchema
methods.description: Attempts to match a schema with provided arguments and returns a matched schema or null.

methods.name: matchSchema
methods.description: Matches schema with arguments, throws error if no match.

methods.name: prefixLine
methods.description: Prefixes each line of a string with a given prefix.

methods.name: matchSchemas
methods.description: Tries multiple schemas to find a matching one, with error handling.

methods.name: packOutputs
methods.description: Packages function outputs into a tuple or single value following Python rules.

methods.name: emitBuiltinNode
methods.description: Creates a node in the graph for a matched operator schema.

methods.name: getFullSchemaName
methods.description: Constructs the full name of a schema including overload if present.

methods.name: emitBuiltinCall
methods.description: Finds and emits a node for a builtin operator call based on name and argument types.
